facts.text: Eckerd College begins the first year with a three-week Autumn Term orientation where students focus exclusively on one course for credit.

sources.title: Autumn Term & Ceremony of Lights - Eckerd College
sources.quote: Our orientation lasts three whole weeks. You focus on one class for credit, meet other first-year students and learn the ideas and habits you'll need for the next four years.

facts.text: Eckerd College allows residential students to bring family pets to live with them on campus.

sources.title: Policy - Housing | Eckerd College
sources.quote: Eckerd College is unique in allowing residential students the privilege of having their family pets live with them on campus.
